statement.text:
Let ℓ(X) denote the composition length of a finite group X. Let A be a finite
nilpotent group acting by automorphisms on a finite soluble group G. Let c(G, A)
be the number of trivial A-modules in a given A-composition series of G. (Note that
c(G, A) = ℓ(CG (A)) if (|A|, |G|) = 1.)
    Conjecture: there are absolute constants C1 and C2 such that the Fitting height
of G is at most C1 ℓ(A) + C2 c(G, A).                                     İ. Güloǧlu
